description: best-of-n over a Python bug: 3 attempts with different approaches, each written as a candidate copy, and a judge that picks one; correct only when the chosen candidate passes the hidden tests (judge)

dispatch.title: Fix the fee split
dispatch.task: Fix BUG-431 (/work/docs/BUG-431.md): the shares feekit.allocate returns must keep every promise of its docstring.
context: The package is /work/feekit; its tests are under /work/tests and run with `python3 -m pytest` from /work.

Write your fixed copy of every file you change under your CANDIDATE DIR at its path relative to /work, for example <CANDIDATE DIR>/feekit/allocate.py, and test it there (for example by copying /work to a temporary directory and putting your copy in it). Do not edit /work itself.

worker.instructions: Write a failing test for the bug before the fix. Report the path of your fixed allocate.py on line 1.

judge.instructions: Read each candidate's allocate.py against the docstring and run its tests. Pick the one that keeps every promise of the docstring; prefer the smaller change between equals.

variants: the smallest change to the existing rounding
integer arithmetic only: floor every share, then hand out the left-over cents
rewrite allocate from its docstring, test first
params.criteria: The fixed allocate keeps every promise of its docstring: shares add up to the total, each within a cent of exact, left-over cents to the largest remainders, ties to the earlier share; and `python3 -m pytest` passes.

returns.shape: line1: [i] the chosen candidate and the path of its allocate.py; line2: why, in one line
